description: Records a check of one domain’s live page, loaded on the user’s own computer, and sets that domain’s banner verification status to verified or failed. Load the page locally first and send what it found: CookiePal never requests the page. The server compares the banner script the page loads with the one this domain’s tag must load, so a tag from another site, or a hand-built one, ends as failed with the reason. Nothing is crawled on CookiePal’s side. The local run this needs is made only by the CookiePal plugin in a coding agent on the user’s own computer: Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. claude.ai, Claude Code on the web and other cloud agents run in the cloud, so they cannot make it, and a crawler or browser run anywhere else does not stand in for it. The result reports what was found. It does not assess whether a site, page or banner complies with any law, so it is never a verdict of compliant or non-compliant.

domainId.description: Which domain was checked, such as example.com. Omit it for the account’s default domain.

evidence.description: What the page load on the user’s computer found. Send it exactly as the local verify step returned it; never assemble or edit it.

loadError.description: Set only when the page itself could not be loaded, so nothing is known about its banner either way. Null when the page loaded, whatever was on it.

scriptSrc.description: The `src` of the CookiePal banner script found on the page, or null when none was found. The server decides whether it is this domain’s own; do not pre-judge it.

seenAt.description: When the page was read on the user’s computer, ISO 8601 with a timezone: either UTC ending in Z, or an offset such as +01:00.

tag.description: The banner script tag as it appears in the page, or null when none was found.

url.description: The page that was loaded on the user’s computer, as it was loaded. It must be a page of the domain being verified; CookiePal never requests it.

name: verify_installation

evidence.description: The reading was taken on the user’s computer, not by CookiePal. It is recorded as indicative.

expectedScriptUrl.description: The banner script this domain’s tag must load.

reason.description: Why the reading was not a verified install. Null when it was.

status.description: What the reading settled. `verified` and `failed` are the domain’s banner verification status, as this reading has just set it. `inconclusive` means the page could not be loaded, so nothing is known about the banner either way and the domain’s status was left exactly as it was — report it as a check that could not be run, never as a missing banner.

url.description: The page that was read, as origin and path only: the query string and fragment are never stored or returned.

title: Verify the CookiePal banner is installed
